eventDetail.scope: IBITeC 2026 focuses on advancements in biomedical instrumentation and technology, integrating artificial intelligence, bioengineering, and digital healthcare systems. The conference covers areas such as biomedical engineering, health informatics, bioinformatics, communication technologies for healthcare, and rehabilitation engineering. It aims to promote interdisciplinary research and innovation to support intelligent healthcare ecosystems and future global health solutions.
